description: Simulated results: Agent-based model of short-term and long-term allocation of electric vehicle charging resources in Netlogo is a model or code deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Mylene van der Koogh, Zofia Lukszo. The allocation of charging resources was simulated with three roll-out strategies to prioritize new charging infrastructure in 9 neighborhoods. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
